title: Correct inherited XSD attributes and type relations
owner: M8 coordinator / assigned isolated M8-xsd-type-relations worker
api_or_output: Correct existing XSD1.0 component behavior without public or frozen API changes

acceptance.description: Accept original particlesZ012/Z015/Z020 by implementing union-member simple derivation in compiler substitution validation and runtime substitution membership; preserve head block/final and unrelated-type rejection, nested union/member-derived cases and shared work. Runtime membership must use the union-aware relation in the content-model compiler, retaining existing precomputed member arrays and shared charging; prove newly admitted member UPA participation. No matcher/evaluator/model/API changes.

Accept original particlesZ031: distinguish simple type definitions from complex types with simple content; inherit simple content and attributes for an empty complexContent extension, reject added element particles and preserve derivation rules.

Restore unmentioned base attribute uses during restriction, except effective overrides/direct prohibitions. Omit prohibited declarations from attribute-group components. Prove original attZ015, ctE019/ctF013/ctG001/ctG013, particlesZ002 and Suncombined009 test.11.v/test.3.v/test.5.v. Preserve constraints, contexts, locations, required/default/fixed behavior and direct/group prohibition distinction; do not inherit base wildcard as a shortcut.

Accept unchanged XSD1.0 originals stZ007, stZ047 and stZ055 by retaining inherited anySimpleType as the content datatype only for complex simpleContent restriction with no inline simpleType and no facets. Keep the complex component distinct with its actual BaseType and Restriction, and preserve final, attribute and other restriction checks. Explicit simple-type restriction of anySimpleType, nonempty facets and a complex base forbidding restriction still reject; inline simple types follow ordinary validation. This implements Second Edition 3.4.2 case1.2 and identical-type derivation, not the XSD1.1 fresh anonymous datatype rule.

Preserve original baselines and independent standards oracles; pass focused owned/affected checks, public/frozen APIs, normal/XML-only consumers, bounded actual allocation evidence and planning validation. No XSD1.1 union-facet rule imported; disputed stZ073b remains separate.

handoff.summary: Ordered repair planned from unchanged original corpus witnesses and independent source/Second Edition review. Not claimed or implemented; no unverified peer dependency consumption. Pre-claim ownership review found independent runtime SubstitutionType follows only BaseType; exact ContentModels/Compiler.cs ownership and verified fixed-restriction dependency added before implementation.
